reasons: Claimed status is compliant and, consistent with that, no redline or comment is proposed — the rendered paragraphs are unchanged from the originals, which is the expected output.

The cited text supports compliance: Section 3.1 (p0019) creates only a revenue-share obligation (30% of Net Sales above an $11,000/month floor), i.e., fees keyed to actual sales rather than any committed volume or spend; there is no take-or-pay, minimum purchase, shortfall make-whole, or volume cap on the Company.
The $11,000 figure is correctly characterized as a threshold below which nothing is owed (favorable to us), not a minimum commitment.
The exit test in the rule's fallback is satisfied on the face of p0024: a one-year term with automatic one-year renewals terminable by either Party on 90 days' notice.

The treatment of the Section 4.2(a) Termination Payment (p0026) is reasonable and correctly scoped: it is an exit charge computed from achieved trailing Net Sales, not a penalty for missing a committed volume, so it belongs under a termination-fee/early-exit rule rather than MINCOMMIT. Flagging it there remains advisable, as the formula can create material priced-exit exposure.
No deterministic check failures; nothing in the supplied paragraphs or definitions contradicts the rationale.
